The '''Waterspouts''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who were presumably composed of hydrogen compounds. A female waterspout was present as a manager at [[Crseih Station]]'s [[Crater Lodge]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] where [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hethrir]] and other members of the [[Empire Reborn]] movement were lodging while trading in kidnapped [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and paying a visit to the mysterious "faith-healer" [[Waru]]. Prior to a [[Confrontation on Crseih Station|skirmish]] on the station, she reprimanded [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo's]] son [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] for allowing his pet bat-like [[tappratine]] to feed on an expensive fish from the pools which decorated the lodge. In response, [[Rillao]] offered to compensate for the loss by having the fish placed on their hotel account.
